summary: MØNE AS (org. no. 914 738 318) is a private limited company (AS) based in Nannestad, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2015-01-02. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 764 427. Board chair: Nils Jørgen Holter.
